MOBILE SHOOTER ERGONOMICS REVIEW. Improve the visible touch-control UI and responsive layout of the Onslaught source reconstruction without changing the established event-driven input architecture or breaking desktop. Focus on thumb reach, hit-target sizing, spacing, safe areas, landscape phones, avoiding overlap with HUD/start/game-over UI, clear distinction between move/look/fire/ADS/reload/slide/weapon controls, and keeping enemies visible. Preserve the rule that touch controls are hidden and non-interactive while gameplay is not running. Keep the dark survival shooter visual language restrained and readable. Prefer conservative CSS/DOM changes around the existing mobile source bridge. Return a coherent unified diff within the allowlisted scope and exact tests to run. Do not claim tests were run.
